tools.name: samita_list_wholesale_pricings
tools.description: List wholesale pricing rules (B2B price rules) of the store, with title, status and the customers and products each rule applies to. Samita's endpoint docs allow about 1 request per 5 minutes per store, so do not call this in a loop. Samita API: GET /wholesale-pricings.

tools.name: samita_get_wholesale_pricing
tools.description: Get one wholesale pricing rule by id, with its customer and product rules and discount groups. Samita's endpoint docs allow about 1 request per 5 minutes per store, so do not call this in a loop. Samita API: GET /wholesale-pricings/{id}.

tools.name: samita_list_volume_pricings
tools.description: List volume pricing rules (quantity or amount discount tiers) of the store, with title, status, type and the products each rule applies to. Samita's endpoint docs allow about 1 request per 5 minutes per store, so do not call this in a loop. Samita API: GET /volume-pricings.

tools.name: samita_get_volume_pricing
tools.description: Get one volume pricing rule by id, with its type (quantity or amount), product rules and tier ranges. Samita's endpoint docs allow about 1 request per 5 minutes per store, so do not call this in a loop. Samita API: GET /volume-pricings/{id}.
